mcqs.question: What FY 2026–27 growth forecast did the World Bank assign to India, raising it from its April 2026 estimate?
mcqs.explanation: The World Bank raised India’s FY 2026–27 growth forecast to 7.1%, up from 6.6% in April 2026. The figure 7.8% refers to Q1 growth, while 2022–23 is the base year used for GDP estimates by the NSO.
